G00.title: Baseline, approval and existing-PR reconciliation
G00.accept: Verify pinned baseline/model/tokenizer hashes, PR19 divergence and rollback backup; no original checkpoint mutation.
G00.security: No source edits or activation before approval; do not overwrite original data.

G01.title: Identity, policy, schemas, audit and secrets
G01.accept: Deny forged actors, stale MFA/grants, cross-account references and post-approval argument changes with zero side effects; preserve old DB writers.
G01.security: Server-owned identity; capability/action grants and emergency stop, secret references only.

G02.title: Isolated execution, files, shell, Git and egress
G02.accept: Owned container/VM runs real bounded tools; reject forbidden file/network/process access, junction/symlink escapes and missing sandbox; no host fallback.
G02.security: No unrestricted model shell; rootless/nonroot workers, quotas, pinned images, approvals and network deny by default.

G03.title: Typed model turns and autonomous runtime
G03.accept: Actual selected Zenith checkpoint completes frozen multi-step workflows with valid schemas, error recovery, budgets, attribution and cancellation; malformed calls have no effects.
G03.security: Model output is a proposal, never authorization; preserve generate/stream and current model weights.

G04.title: Durable sessions, tasks, events, HTTP/WebSocket/CLI
G04.accept: Real HTTP/WS admission, replay, ownership, lease fencing and restart/cancel; uncertain non-idempotent writes reconcile instead of replay.
G04.security: Authenticate and scope live/replayed events; bounded frames/queues; no global bearer-to-owner promotion.

G05.title: Persistent scoped memory and context compression
G05.accept: Account/project recall, deletion/TTL, provenance, bounded context, compression checkpoint/recovery and retrieval relevance on frozen labels; no private/shared-corpus crossover.
G05.security: Treat retrieved text/inferences as data, isolate namespaces and redact provider egress; no duplicate personal-memory DB.

G06.title: Reviewed learning, trajectories, skill candidates and workflow discovery
G06.accept: Generate a real candidate from consented successful/failed traces, test on independent fixtures, review/activate/version/rollback; optional continued training preserves parent and retained quality.
G06.security: No unreviewed live code/weight changes; exclude secrets, held-out data and provider outputs without permitted training rights.

G07.title: Plugin/skill packages, MCP and dynamic discovery
G07.accept: Pinned manifest/schema/protocol negotiation, actual isolated invocation, tool/resource discovery, cancellation, auth/revocation and upgrade reapproval; malformed packages fail closed.
G07.security: No untrusted import in host; discovery is not permission or implicit dependency installation.

G08.title: Supervisor, specialist children and shared task graph
G08.accept: Real supervisor/child goal completion, isolated workspaces, strict-subset grants, collective budgets, cancel/steer, blocked-input/review handoff and recovery.
G08.security: No automatic parent admin-cookie/MFA inheritance, no model self-elevation or unauthenticated inter-agent events.

G09.title: Channels, identity routing, notifications and delivery
G09.accept: Each separately inventoried service proves owned-account pairing, valid/invalid signatures, replay rejection, text/media/thread semantics and uncertain-send reconciliation; no test double counts as live service verification.
G09.security: Explicit account/chat/thread bindings, allowlists, message-send approvals, scoped credentials and PII-safe metadata.

G10.title: Schedules, heartbeat, triggers and event workflows
G10.accept: Durable UTC/cron+timezone jobs with tested DST/misfire/overlap policy, standing-authority expiry, event dedup and restart recovery.
G10.security: Never reuse expired login/MFA sessions as permanent job authority; approve external effects individually or with narrow standing grants.

G11.title: Browser, computer, remote environments and credential vault
G11.accept: Actual isolated browser/VM/owned SSH endpoint, all-subresource egress checks, private-profile exclusion, approval-bound writes, cancellation and cleanup; missing backend is unavailable.
G11.security: Do not import host cookies/keychains or send secrets to model context; origin-bind handles and human payment/credential actions.

G12.title: Multimodal documents, images, audio, video and voice
G12.accept: Real licensed compatible backends with bounded files, OCR/STT/TTS/vision/media fixtures and declared failure/unsupported formats; preserve text-only installation.
G12.security: Do not splice an arbitrary encoder into Zenith embeddings; scan/limit media, isolate decoders and scope all provider egress.

G13.title: Provider and infrastructure connectors
G13.accept: Exact account-visible model IDs, local-default/privacy routing, errors/failover and actual least-privilege owned API/database/host operations; unsupported/restricted models unavailable.
G13.security: No account-access assumptions, no embedded keys, no secret-bearing provider output in training without permission.

G14.title: CLI/TUI/web/desktop/mobile applications
G14.accept: Real target-OS builds, login/task/approval/reconnect/accessibility/media workflows and identity/model attribution; no native-client claim from Linux-only unit tests.
G14.security: Keep Zenith branding/core; transport owns auth, renderer cannot grant permissions, platform prompts/signing/entitlements respected.

G15.title: Packaging, deployment, benchmarks and acceptance release
G15.accept: Frozen paired reference/Zenith tests, security/retention/performance regressions, Windows/Linux CPU and optional GPU/remote/container/companion jobs, model-hash and rollback drills; publish only actual results.
G15.security: Default-off experiments, immutable parent checkpoint, signed/pinned artifacts and dependency notices; no automatic unverified deployment.
